excerpt: Beam has already been established in Linac and Booster (Aug 26), MI will start up on September 21, stable beam is planned for October 1. The plan is for 12 weeks of operation in FY27, with a stretch goal of 20 weeks of operation, with a focus on the NuMI beam.
